sections.indications_and_usage: When using this product: do not exceed the recommended dosage. frequent or prolonged use may cause nasal congestion to recur or worsen. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Adults and children 6 years of age and older: Shake well before use. Spray 2–3 times into each nostril. Use every 10–12 hours. Do not use more than 2 times in any 24-hour period. Children under 6 years of age: Ask a doctor before use.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings Ask a doctor before use if you have: heart disease high blood pressure thyroid disease diabetes trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate
